mentions.name: Bambu 3D printer alternative client
mentions.description: A replacement front end for Bambu 3D printers that works entirely over the LAN without Bambu's cloud account or apps. It provides a simple upload-and-monitor UI, supports multiple printers stacked and managed from a single page, pulls a reliable camera feed as a series of still images, and can onboard just-unboxed printers via SSID info on the SD card with zero cloud or app contact. It is wrapped in a small Python launcher for dock-based launching, and the author plans to open source it.
mentions.problem: Bambu's printers are best-in-class but their software is intrusive and proprietary: setup pushes a cloud account or app, updates have disabled functionality making LAN-only mode untrustworthy, camera feeds are janky, and LAN-only sync fails silently — and the apps break completely behind custom VLANs/SSIDs.
mentions.source_excerpt: I had opus vibe out a replacement front end that gives me a simple upload and monitor UI for my A1, and it just kept hitting stretch goals. I added support for multiple printers so you can see them stacked on a single page and manage all of them from one place. And it even works on just-unboxed models that have never been through the official setup.
